# simply_dns_record (Data Source)

Looks up a DNS record in a Simply.com product DNS zone.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "simply_dns_record" "www" {
  product = "example.com"
  name    = "www"
  type    = "CNAME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `product` (String) Simply.com product object, usually the domain name.

### Optional

- `data` (String) DNS record data.
- `name` (String) Record name within the DNS zone.
- `priority` (Number) Priority value.
- `record_id` (Number) Simply.com DNS record ID.
- `type` (String) DNS record type.

### Read-Only

- `comment` (String) Record comment.
- `id` (String) Data source ID in the form `product:record_id`.
- `ttl` (Number) Record TTL in seconds.
